registered_addition_groups.rationale: All registered occurrences are confined to a standard-library static audit checker: local lists/sets/maps used to parse reviewed Markdown tables, collect validation errors/results, and one SHA-256 candidate-id computation over fixed design material. The checker does not import or execute legacy goal runtime, drive runtime, persistence runtime, M3-E code, speech, scheduler, action, memory/vector/model/AGP mutation, or production I/O. It provides no production capability and cannot transfer legacy goal-domain authority.
